content:
**Hello! Hello! Hello..! Hello...!**

We’ve put in system-wide echo cancellation on Windows clients! Historically, echo cancellation was focused on just audio from Discord calls; nothing else happening on your PC was accounted for. Now, we attempt to remove a much broader set of things, which should result in your friends complaining less about being able to hear the video you got playing on your second monitor.

It’ll also surely cancel out any distractions while you see what else we got in this changelog:

What's New {added}
===

🎷 **New Fonts and Styles** 

Oh, you like fonts? Then name every typeface. Here, we’ll give you a head start with the 4 newest fonts that you can customize your name with if you’ve got Nitro: *Monkey Bars, Mainframe, Headbang, and Journal.*

We’re also hitting you with a couple tasty new name effects: *Gummy and Prism!*

🎷 **Trending Games**


We’ve made some adjustments to the [Trending Games](http://discord.com/trending-games) page to allow you to filter it a bit.

You can now peep trending games in entire genres! Click the genre name to check out some of the top trending indie or FPS games each week —  you might find something new and fresh to play with your friends!



🎷 **Bulk-leave inactive group DMs**


It happens to us all: you get added to the 50th group DM with the same people. Now you got 49 group DMs clogging up your DM list…

Clear em out! Leave all the inactive group DMs that haven’t seen a message in a while. Ahh, doesn’t that feel much better?

🎷 **Audio-device icons**


Sometimes you got the homies in the headset, sometimes you want to use your desktop speakers. No judgement here on what you use, but how on EARTH can you tell those devices apart?!?!

How about with some lil’ icons? No longer will you be confused over the sometimes wild default naming conventions of your devices.

🎷 **Friend-online notification controls**


Some of you have a lot of friends. Like *a lot*. We’re not envious or anything…
Sometimes when those friends come online, you get a couple of notifications.

They can now be adjusted to be as frequent as you want, or off entirely if you so desire! You can also edit these settings as both the sender AND the receiver.

🎷 **@game mentions on mobile**

You could ping @game on Desktop and get info on a game or to join their official server in many cases. We brought that to mobile too! Get to pinging! Just not @everyone in a big server please!

What's Better {improved}
===

🎷 **Profile Bio Character Limit Increase**


You’ve got a lot to say about yourself, and we don’t blame you, you’re pretty cool! We’ve bumped the amount of characters that you can write in your bio from 190 to 300.

Be sure to make it look just as cool as you are using the WYSIWYG editor that we talked about in the previous changelog!

🎷 **Server tag edits on mobile**


Quick little update for the server tag editors of the world: you can now edit them on mobile! For when you gotta change your tag the moment you’ve summited Mt. Everest. Is there cell reception up there actually?

As an added bonus, your server tag will now appear properly and proudly on your server profile —  even on mobile!



🎷 **Town Hall Revamp**

We’ve revamped the [Discord Town Hall](https://discord.gg/discord-townhall), also known as the Discord Discord, to be a place where you can get product updates, learn about collabs, see what experiments are running, and more. We’re open any time, stop by and say what up!

🎷 **Mobile visual refresh**


Discord on mobile has been brought in line with desktop. The two should feel like one Discord. The OG dark theme’s back. People are circles, and things are squircles. The chat bar has more breathing room.
More details on the [blog ](https://discord.com/blog/improving-mobile-with-squircles-styles-and-spacing)if you’re so inclined.



What's Under The Hood {fixed}
==============================

For those of you who want even MORE of the technical details, we’ve got our [patch notes](https://discord.com/blog/discord-patch-notes-september-8-2026) fresh out of the oven and right onto your proverbial plate.

🎷 **Discord Patch Notes: Sept 2026 Highlights**


- React Native upgrade: We upgraded our mobile apps from React Native .81 to .86, resulting in roughly 5% lower average CPU usage and 5% faster app launches across Android and iOS.
- Electron 42 upgrade: Upgrading Desktop to Electron 42 and changing how we use it improved p50 CPU usage by ~17%, with a small ~4% increase in p50 memory usage. More resources for gaming, where they belong.
- Desktop rendering optimizations: Another round of optimizations reduced unnecessary rendering, improving p50 CPU usage by ~3%.

What's Up? {improved}
====================

You may venture through articles past and read through everything we’ve changed if you’re so inclined. You can see the Patch Notes of old[ here](https://discord.com/tags/patch-notes), or check out our[ archive of past Changelogs](https://discord.com/tags/changelog).

And, of course, we’re always all ears for any bugs that you might stumble upon. Check out our[ Bimonthly Bug Megathread](https://dis.gd/reddit-bug-megathread) on the community-run r/DiscordApp subreddit and tell us what you’ve found. Our Engineering team will be more than happy to check it out.

Make a **BOLD** *first* impression with new formatting tools on desktop to help put the finishing touches on your bio without having to memorize Markdown. Apparently, it’s called a “WYSIWYG” editor, which is really fun to say. *WYSIWYSIWYSIWIG.*

Now it’s time for a LOITWAODL, or: a `List Of Improvements That Were Added On Discord Lately`:

- **You can now set your profile as “Private.”** Blind others with the majesty of your bio with everyone, just smaller servers, or just those you *actually* have added as a friend.
- **Attach a note when sending a friend request** to tell why you’re adding someone, that way your future buddy won’t ask “who the hell is this again?”
- **New spoiler channels** make server members say “yeah man i wanna see it” before viewing a text channel, without moderators having to mark the entire channel as Age Restricted as a workaround.
- **On desktop, share a game by mentioning it**. By typing `@game`, you can search for any game with a Discord profile and embed it in your message, like `@game Palworld` or `@game Sunderfolk`. Mobile support in the works**!**
- **Goggle-wearers rejoice: Discord’s on Meta Quest!** Keep the app pinned in your virtual environment while playing a VR game, or like, boiling eggs. With your headset on.
- **Frame your picture-perfect profile** by adding one of the newest profile customization options in the Shop: [Frames](https://discord.com/blog/introducing-profile-frames-decorative-borders-to-make-your-discord-profile-museum-worthy)!

Looking for something perfect to play or stream for your upcoming game night? Our new **Trending Games page** is updated every Thursday with what’s been popular across all of Discord, including both single-player and multiplayer games. 

[Check out what's popular on Discord this week](https://discord.com/trending-games) and get some new game ideas to play with your friends during your next game night. 

📱 Mighty Mobile Updates {improved}
================

- Tappitytap-**Tap to React lets you double-tap to quickly react to any message with a preset emoji.** You can assign a particular emoji as your Tap to React shortcut in User Settings > Chat. 
- **You 🫵 raise the Bar.** A new “You Bar” on mobile gives more prominence to your identity and helps simplify navigation. Tap it to view your profile, or [peek at our blog post about it](https://discord.com/blog/you-bar).
- **Mobile users will now be asked if they reeaally wanted to call that DM** or Group DM before ringing the entire chat at once. No more accidentally scaring the group at 3am.
- **On iOS, photos upload a bit quicker** thanks to some compression and latency optimizations. We’re talkin’ 17% smaller files, and around 12% lower latency. 
- **Wishlists are now on mobile**, letting you add Shop items to your profile’s Wishlist wherever you find yourself. You can even peek at other people’s wishlists on their profiles while going… outside.  

💬 Chats, Channels, and In-Game Comms {improved}
================

- **Queue up with friends easier through Discord & Riot account linking!** [Rolling out to League of Legends and VALORANT](https://discord.com/blog/making-it-easier-than-ever-to-connect-with-friends-in-league-val), you’ll be able to see your Discord friends list in-game and invite a Discord friend directly from the game client.
- **Pin DMs and Group DMs** to keep them at the top of your DM list. You can also pin channels to the top of a server’s channel list to avoid trudging through hundreds of similarly-named channels. 
- **Invites to join voice now show who's hanging out**, that way you’re not accidentally jump-scaring someone streaming Resident Evil Requiem upon joining. 
- **Say “👋 hi uwu” to your new best friend!** On desktop, after you add someone new, you’ll be encouraged to send them a friendly wave within your DM list. You can still send whatever you’d like, though.
- **Game Profile pages got an upgrade.** Click a game’s name while someone’s playing to see screenshots, what platforms it’s on, Steam/OpenCritic reviews, how popular it is on Discord, a link to the game’s official server, and more. 

If you’re down for some more ||new feature spoilers||, take a peek at our [monthly Patch Notes](https://discord.com/tags/patch-notes)! There’s a LOT of fixes listed in the latest entry, so go grab, like, a sandwich or something. A peanut butter, banana, and corn chip sandwich. (hey, don’t knock it ‘til you try it.)
